title: PQC SDK Agent Tools
description: OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini tool-call schema for @pqc-sdk/core. Load this at agent startup to enable post-quantum cryptographic operations. Secret keys never pass through the model context: tools refer to them by keyId, and the host keeps the keys in its own keystore.

tools.name: pqc_keygen
tools.description: Generate a post-quantum key pair and store it in the host keystore. Returns its keyId and a public token (safe to share); the secret key never leaves the host. Use 'x-wing' or 'ml-kem-768' for encryption, 'ml-dsa-65' for digital signatures.

algorithm.description: Algorithm to use. For encryption: ml-kem-768 (recommended, FIPS 203 cat.3), ml-kem-512 (lighter, cat.1), ml-kem-1024 (strongest, cat.5), x-wing (hybrid PQ+classical). For signatures: ml-dsa-65 (recommended, FIPS 204 cat.3), ml-dsa-44 (lighter), ml-dsa-87 (strongest).

keyId.description: Id of the stored key. Pass it to pqc_decrypt or pqc_sign.

publicToken.description: Public key token (pqcv1.* format). Safe to share with other agents.

tools.name: pqc_list_keys
tools.description: List the keys in the host keystore. Secret keys are never returned.

tools.name: pqc_encrypt
tools.description: Encrypt data for a recipient using their public key token. Pass exactly one of plaintext (UTF-8 text) or plaintextBase64 (binary data). The result can only be decrypted by the holder of the matching secret key. Quantum-resistant.

ciphertextHex.description: Hex-encoded ciphertext. Safe to transmit over any channel.

tools.name: pqc_decrypt
tools.description: Decrypt a ciphertext with a stored key, by keyId. Returns text when the plaintext is valid UTF-8, otherwise base64. Fails if the ciphertext is tampered, truncated, or was not encrypted for this key.

keyId.description: Id of a stored key, as returned by pqc_keygen or pqc_list_keys.

tools.name: pqc_sign
tools.description: Sign a message with a stored ML-DSA key, by keyId. Disabled unless the host operator enables it. The signature proves the message came from the holder of this key and was not modified. Quantum-resistant.

keyId.description: Id of a stored key, as returned by pqc_keygen or pqc_list_keys.

signatureHex.description: Hex-encoded signature. Attach to the message when sending to other agents.

tools.name: pqc_verify
tools.description: Verify a ML-DSA signature. Returns true if the message was signed by the holder of the secret key matching this public key, and was not modified since signing.

message.description: The original message that was signed.

publicToken.description: Signer's ML-DSA public key token (pqcv1.ml-dsa-*.public.* format).

verified.description: true = genuine signature; false = tampered, wrong key, or wrong message.

tools.name: pqc_algorithms
tools.description: List all supported algorithms. Use this to let the agent discover what is available before calling pqc_keygen.

fips.description: NIST-standardized subset (FIPS 203 + FIPS 204). Cite these in compliance claims; x-wing is excluded.

security_rules: Secret keys never pass through the model context: no tool accepts or returns secret key material; tools refer to secret keys by keyId.
Keep secret keys in a keystore the model cannot read directly; grant it only keys whose plaintexts it may see (pqc_decrypt returns plaintext to the model).
Expose pqc_sign only when the operator explicitly enables it.
Rotate KEM key pairs after each session or after a fixed number of encrypt/decrypt operations.
Always verify (pqc_verify) before trusting a decrypted message from another agent.
Use FIPS algorithms (pqc_algorithms.fips) for compliance-sensitive operations.
